proposed_endpoint.label: Prospective public representation agreement with exact native instants (UTC report display; review only)

instruction_revision.ancestor_text: For Q3 and Q8, this contract interprets the published local-time display in the contemporaneous time zone addressed by Q4. Submit a source-supported explicit offset; the public profile does not disclose that offset. This is a declared comparison convention, not proof of the original display configuration.
instruction_revision.proposed_text: For Q3 and Q8, render source-supported instants in UTC as the explicit report display convention. Preserve the native source timestamp, exact instant, and every fractional digit in the frozen supporting metadata. Report display timezone is an explicit presentation convention; it does not establish the machine historical local timezone. Native source timestamp retained.

field_proposals.meaning: Exact ProductName recorded in the selected operating-system configuration.
Recorded label and explicit signed numeric UTC offset under the existing reviewed registry-bias correspondence.

field_proposals.source_precision_limitation: The formatter preserves supplied fractional digits exactly; it cannot restore precision discarded by the source reader. Review raw source precision separately.

exact_instant_implementation_limitation.existing_benchmark_datetime_parsing: May truncate fractional digits beyond six places; zero tolerance alone does not establish exact native-precision comparison.
exact_instant_implementation_limitation.timestamp_predicates: Exact integer comparison supports at most seven fractional digits (100ns).
exact_instant_implementation_limitation.report_display_formatter: Preserves arbitrarily many supplied fractional digits without truncation.
exact_instant_implementation_limitation.future_comparator_requirement: Review an explicit precision policy and exact-instant parser before activation; do not assume the existing matcher implements the proposed zero-tolerance precision.

review_requirements: Review the changed public endpoint, case ID, contract revision and explicit replacement of the prior local-display instruction.
Review the exact zone label plus signed-offset equivalence and declared label_mode independently of private expected values.
Review source precision and exact-instant comparison without tolerance, rounding or fraction truncation; Q8 precision matching remains unapproved.
Independent reviewer must establish a separate reference alignment before any prospective comparison; alignment remains unresolved.
Preserve the frozen ancestor, measured submissions and historical results; do not retroactively rescore or relabel them.
